theme: The boat winds down; the trip home begins.
greeting: Your last full day on the water, Dan. The calendar's empty, but the weekend's handoffs and Sunday's Tampa landing are what actually need you.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat handoff and the Sunday dawn checkout
needsAttention.detail: You're off the boat at noon Saturday and out the door around 5:15 AM Sunday for the flight home. The Komolac transfer, an early bag hold, and an express checkout all still read as open on your travel list.

needsAttention.title: No car booked for the Tampa landing
needsAttention.detail: You land Tampa 3:55 PM Sunday and the Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV is still flagged unbooked. A jet-lagged Sunday walk-up rate is exactly the thing this reservation avoids.

needsAttention.title: St Pete gap, Sunday and Monday nights
needsAttention.detail: The kids aren't picked up until Tuesday, so you need somewhere in St Pete for the 20th and 21st before the Orlando villa. Still open on your list.

flagged.title: A warm intro from Brunswick
flagged.detail: You were connected with Brunswick's senior recruitment lead, who already has your resume—a reply is owed.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message from Claudia Kruse
flagged.detail: She messaged you a few days ago; it's sitting unanswered.

flagged.title: Revolut card dispatched
flagged.detail: Your new card is on its way, arriving Sept 23–25.

inbox.noise: Around a dozen newsletters and promos—Noah Smith, Alison Roman, two recipe shops, an Italian-word list, a Duke tailgate invite.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: Autumn's first pumpkins and cool evenings call for a spiced, custardy pie.

tasks.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV (refundable, PWM)

acts.line: A last stretch of open water before Saturday's noon handback at Komolac.
The calendar's clear—today is the boat, not the desk.
Croatia is hours ahead, so the day has already wound down where you are.
